highlights: The Hotel Staff set is described as the hotel staff gathered in one pin collection.

A second set, The Vees, is also offered at the same price, so you can choose the group you prefer.

sections.p: The Hotel Staff Pin Set is described as the hotel staff in one pin collection: four premium hard enamel pins featuring Alastor, Angel Dust, Charlie and Vaggie. The Set option also includes The Vees at the same price.

It suits Hazbin Hotel fans who like the hotel staff and want a ready-made pin collection, and it makes an easy gift for a fan. After you order, delivery typically takes 7–14 business days. Tracking is sent by email.

cautions: The listing text only describes the Hotel Staff set and does not say which pins come in The Vees set, so ask the concierge before choosing it.
The pins' size is not stated in the listing, and once the seller order is placed it cannot be cancelled except for defects or wrong items, so check your set choice before ordering.

cautions: 상품 설명은 Hotel Staff 세트만 설명하고 The Vees 세트에 어떤 핀이 들어 있는지는 적혀 있지 않아요. 선택하기 전에 컨시어지에게 문의해 주세요.
핀 크기는 상품 정보에 없고, 판매처 주문이 들어가면 불량이나 오배송이 아닌 한 취소할 수 없어요. 세트 선택을 주문 전에 꼭 다시 확인해 주세요.
